output.headline: Harbour City push, but Ironvale's block holds
output.text: Down 0-1, Harbour City carry the momentum at 25. Ruiz's 26.6-metre progressive pass and Kowalski's carry set up a shot from 6.9 metres, but it was blocked. Their xG is 0.27 against Ironvale's 1.63, so the pressure is still not producing chances.
